result:
Both gates are green: `go vet` clean, `go test` passes (includes `TestExecRunnerDeadline`, which covers both the stuck-command-times-out and fast-path-unchanged cases).

Summary of the state I restored (`internal/agent/report.go`):
- `ExecRunner.Run` now wraps `exec.CommandContext` with an internal `execRunnerTimeout` (5 min default, unexported so the test can lower it), returning a `"timed out after ..."` error on deadline exceeded.
- `CommandRunner` interface and all call sites (`runCommand`, `gitProbe.git`) are untouched — only `ExecRunner.Run`'s body changed.
- `report_test.go` adds `TestExecRunnerDeadline` with two subtests: a stuck `sleep 5` under a 50ms timeout returns promptly with a timeout error, and a fast `echo hello` under a normal timeout returns unchanged output.

Working tree is clean; no further changes needed since the required fix was already the checked-in state at `HEAD` and I confirmed it builds and tests green.
